sources.title: Mount Huaguo (Jiangsu)
sources.excerpt: Mount Huaguo is a mountain located in Haizhou District, Lianyungang, Jiangsu, China. It forms a part of the Yuntai Mountains. The site is best known for being an inspiration for a synonymous legendary mountain in the novel Journey to the West. Its summit, Yunü Peak, is the highest point of Jiangsu province at 625.3 metres (2,052 ft).
